business.howToCard1Text: MrCall introduces itself and recognizes callers by number. Want to change it? Click 'Configure with AI' and describe what you'd like.
business.howToCard2Text: Activate a plan, get a number, and forward calls from your phone to MrCall. With the Professional plan you can connect it to your VoIP PBX.
business.howToCard3Text: Yes! In 'Voice settings' choose between male and female voice. MrCall speaks in the language you selected during setup.
business.howToCard4Text: Absolutely. In the advanced settings, switch on the calendar skills and connect your Google Calendar: MrCall will offer the free slots and book, move and cancel appointments for you.
business.howToCard5Text: Every call generates an email notification with a summary. In 'Your notifications' you can choose what to receive and how.
business.howToCard6Text: In 'Q&A' you teach MrCall how to answer about hours, prices, services. The more info you add, the more accurate it gets.
business.howToCard7Text: Set your closing days and MrCall will automatically inform callers, suggesting when to call back.
business.howToCard8Title: Can I use a fixed script?
business.howToCard8Text: Turn off MrCall AI and the assistant will read a fixed text you write. Less smart, but you have full control over every word.

language.funFactText: The first talking machine was built in 1791 by the Austro-Hungarian inventor Wolfgang von Kempelen. She was my ancestor! And could proudly pronounce "Constantinople". Not bad, right?

business.funFactText: MrCall was born in Italy — and so was the idea of a personal assistant! Ancient Romans had a Nomenclator, a specialised slave whose sole job was to memorise the names, faces and social standing of every person their master might encounter. MrCall does the same thing… but is politically correct.

searchbusinessfunfact.funFactText: The Yellow Pages were invented in 1883 because a printer in Cheyenne, Wyoming ran out of white paper. It became the world's first business directory. Today, we're skipping the paper and the on-hold music. Let's link your Google Business so your assistant can start taking calls right away.

assistantcreatedfunfact.funFactText: Before voicemail was a digital file, it was a human being with a notepad. In the 1930s, the first 'answering machine' was a cabinet the size of a fridge. Today, MrCall is your personal operator — no fridge-sized equipment or whistling required.

mcpConnectors.title: MCP Connectors
mcpConnectors.subtitle: Generate credentials to connect your MrCall account to Claude (or another MCP-compatible AI client).

info.title: How to connect
info.intro: Mint a connector below, then add it as a custom MCP connector in your AI client (Claude, Cursor, etc.) using the MCP URL plus the Client ID and Client Secret returned by the mint step.

create.title: Mint a new connector
create.help: Each connector is a separate set of credentials. Use one per AI client so you can revoke them independently.
create.descriptionPlaceholder: Short note about where this connector is used

list.title: Your connectors
list.empty: No connectors yet. Mint one above to get started.
list.rotateConfirm: Rotate the client secret? The current secret will stop working immediately and you will see the new one only once.

scopes.title: Permissions
scopes.help: Choose what this connector is allowed to do on your behalf. You can revoke it later by rotating its secret or deleting it.

reveal.title: Save your credentials now
reveal.warningTitle: These values will not be shown again.
reveal.warningBody: Copy the URL, client ID, and client secret into your AI client before closing this card. The secret is hashed server-side; if you lose it you must rotate.
reveal.howTo: In Claude → Settings → Custom Connectors → Add custom connector. Paste the values above. Claude will open a browser consent page to finish authorization.

wizard.question: Now I will do web research, figure out how to answer the phone and how to continue the conversation. You can always change my behaviour later.
wizard.agentPrompt: Do web research for this business. Configure how the assistant answers the phone and continues the conversation. Apply the configuration. At the end of your reply, include EXACTLY one block: <plan-recommendation plan="essential|starter|professional">reason in the user's language</plan-recommendation>. Available plans: {plans} Also include EXACTLY one block: <research-summary>two summary lines of what you found about this business on the web (e.g. number of Google reviews and average rating, or the main services)</research-summary>.
wizard.callHelperText: Call to hear your assistant, then pick a plan
wizard.noLinkBody: Heads up: your assistant is not connected to Google My Business, so we don't know who you are — and we can't pre-configure it for you. Make a test call anyway.
wizard.noLinkPs: PS You can always ask the configurator to run a web search and configure your assistant.

wizard.afterCallTrialButton: Try MrCall free for a week
